notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Arbor Adherent with toughness 3 or greater.
description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.
